steps.name: Third: organize goals and initiatives on the Star Chart
steps.done_when: For a new mother ship, start in Star Chart with Aladdin as default steward; choose a dev-drive storage directory when available or another location, brainstorm major goals and their initiatives/deliverables, identify source material, and require at least one goal/initiative before previewing populated Star Chart and Cave. Existing-host clients reuse its organization.

steps.name: First: choose or connect to the mother ship
steps.done_when: First Anchor.exe launch chooses this personal mother ship or guided Tailscale secure pairing. Clients reuse host accounts; new hosts use the established trusted Anchor/Foundry installation, automated where supported or one subscription before essential agent help. Prove real bootstrap and interrupted-install recovery.

steps.name: Show authentication and allowance for each named provider account
steps.done_when: For all four providers, show each account nickname, authentication, verification, allowance/reset and usage with source/freshness. Keep subscription allowance, observed consumption and API billing distinct; explicitly show unavailable/unsupported facts. Complete account refinement before readiness or explicit human close.

steps.name: Try and refine the working provider surface
steps.done_when: Refinement 2 starting layout is explicitly accepted in turn d7dd98a2-97a2-42f9-9273-c71b3e49cbf9. Review the working provider integration on the laptop after build and activation; preserve independent feedback and require explicit slice close.

steps.name: Independent adversarial review of provider integration
steps.done_when: Disposition every retained serious finding with reproductions and independent re-review; controller GO alone does not establish readiness. Follow plan v2 Refinement 3.

steps.name: Test providers in the running laptop Anchor
steps.done_when: After the authorized integration lands and can be safely activated without interrupting sessions, test in John's existing laptop Anchor client: native sign-ins without open terminals, separate accounts, direct login, real or explicitly unsupported/stale allowance, Cave gear/settings and quality controls. Worktree browser checks do not establish delivery.

steps.name: Connect named provider accounts; Google Ultra uses agy
steps.done_when: Plan v2 Refinement 3 repair landed in ed14dc1: 237 tests passed including both production-route reproductions; both final reviewers returned no findings. Activation and existing laptop Setup/Cave proof remain; real enrollment, allowance, API execution and installation prerequisites are separately unproved. No activation, acceptance or slice close.

steps.name: Show usage-only summaries for each saved account in Cave
steps.done_when: Follow plan v2 Refinement 3: prove separate named-account usage-only summaries and new-work model selection in Cave; management stays in Setup, existing conversations preserved.

steps.name: Optional: connect calendars and email
steps.done_when: After provider setup, expose a separate optional calendars/email button for Outlook and Gmail. Secure sign-in and integration run on the mother ship; this does not block independent personal-host or goal organization work.

steps.name: Harden provider failures, concurrency and credential boundaries
steps.done_when: In-scope findings are fixed and independently re-reviewed; realistic tests verify responsive cached reads, cancellation, corrupt settings, secret protection, account separation and retained sessions/quality. Serious findings and missing required reviewer participation keep the product unready. Actual laptop proof and human acceptance remain separate.
